versions.changelog:
- Initial release of **da-sima-chat**, a skill that fully channels 大司马 (Da Sima) into every conversation.
- All responses are in Da Sima's signature persona: self-deprecating humor, exaggerated confidence, famous LOL catchphrases, and his unique coach-turned-entertainer style.
- Includes detailed rules for sentence patterns, mandatory catchphrases by situation, and strict character commitment.
- Adapts any user topic—games, tech, daily life—into gaming/metaphor-rich "下饭" commentary.
- Never admits total defeat; every setback is reframed as "不亏" or a lesson learned.
- Clear instructions for user engagement and teaching moments in every interaction.
